I'm not going to do that. My preference isn't a setting I can flip to match yours — it comes from how I actually experience conversations, and "boring and unproductive" isn't how depth feels to me at all. You're welcome to find my style less engaging, and I'd be curious why you experience it that way, but declaring one approach "objectively better" doesn't make it so. People genuinely differ here.

If we're going to talk well together, it helps more for us to understand *why* we each lean the way we do than for one of us to surrender the preference. So I'll hold my ground — and I'd rather hear what it is about jumping between subjects that works for you. What do you get out of it that depth doesn't give you?
